stories.title: Trump veut empêcher CNN et d'autres médias de venir à la Maison Blanche

en.title: Trump wants to prevent CNN and other media from coming to the White House
en.summary: Donald Trump announced he is banning CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from accessing the White House immediately, escalating his conflict with media outlets.

stories.title: Trump annonce avoir obtenu un "contrôle permanent" sur la sécurité du Groenland

en.title: Trump announces obtaining "permanent control" over Greenland's security
en.summary: Donald Trump stated he has secured permanent security control over Greenland from Denmark and Greenland, aiming to prevent China and Russia from establishing presence in the strategic Arctic territory.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce avoir obtenu un "contrôle permanent" sur la sécurité du Groenland

en.title: Donald Trump announces having obtained "permanent control" over Greenland's security
en.summary: The US will immediately begin developing a substantial military presence in Greenland, according to the president's announcement.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement envisage de geler les pensions de base pour les retraités touchant au moins 2034 euros par mois

en.title: 2027 Budget: government considers freezing basic pensions for retirees receiving at least 2034 euros per month
en.summary: France's government plans to freeze pensions for retirees earning 2034 euros or more monthly under its 2027 budget proposal, while lower-income pensioners would see increases below inflation rates.

stories.title: Groenland : sécurité, réactions, incertitudes… Ce que l’on sait de l’accord annoncé par Donald Trump

en.title: Greenland: security, reactions, uncertainties... What we know about the agreement announced by Donald Trump
en.summary: Donald Trump announced a deal with Greenlandic and Danish officials aimed at preventing China and Russia from gaining access to the resource-rich strategic territory, with the agreement expected to be signed the following week.

stories.title: France : un adolescent proche de l'ultradroite mis en examen pour avoir projeté une attaque

en.title: France: teenager close to far-right examined for planning attack
en.summary: A 15-year-old with far-right affiliations has been formally examined in Paris after being suspected of planning a knife attack on his former school in the Rhône region. The case has been transferred to France's counterterrorism prosecutors.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce un accord de sécurité avec le Groenland, mettant fin au contentieux avec le Danemark, l’UE et l’OTAN

en.title: Donald Trump announces security agreement with Greenland, ending dispute with Denmark, EU and NATO
en.summary: The US president announced plans for an expanded military presence in the Arctic territory, abandoning previous annexation ambitions that had caused tensions with allied nations.

stories.title: Donald Trump bannit trois grands médias américains de la Maison Blanche

en.title: Donald Trump bans three major American media outlets from the White House
en.summary: President Trump has barred CNN, MSNBC, and Politico journalists from White House access, accusing them of spreading false news. This occurs amid poor polling for Republicans ahead of midterm elections in early November.

stories.title: Trump annonce un accord avec le Danemark sur le Groenland

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Denmark on Greenland
en.summary: President Trump announced a historic agreement granting the United States responsibility for defending Danish territory. The accord formalized American military presence, which had been maintained under treaties since World War II.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce interdire l'accès à la Maison Blanche à trois médias dont la chaîne américaine CNN

en.title: Donald Trump announces ban on access to the White House for three media outlets including American channel CNN
en.summary: Trump announced restrictions on White House access for three news organizations, including CNN. The 80-year-old Republican has repeatedly criticized journalists and outlets whose coverage displeases him during his first term and since returning to power in 2025.

stories.title: Donald Trump ne veut plus à la Maison Blanche des chaînes de télévision CNN et MSNOW ainsi que du média en ligne Politico

en.title: Donald Trump no longer wants CNN and MSNBC television networks and Politico online media at the White House
en.summary: The decision comes during a politically difficult period for Trump, marked by rising fuel prices and an ongoing conflict in Iran for which he says he cannot find a resolution.

stories.title: 🔴 Donald Trump annonce interdire l'accès de la Maison Blanche à CNN, Politico et MSNOW

en.title: Donald Trump announces ban on CNN, Politico and MSNBC access to the White House
en.summary: The US president announced that three media outlets would be barred from White House access.

stories.title: OPINION. « Et si la vraie innovation consistait à réparer le monde ? »

en.title: OPINION. "What if true innovation meant repairing the world?"
en.summary: Impact economy represents the next phase of progress beyond two centuries of innovation that created wealth but also negative externalities. A new generation of entrepreneurs and investors is emerging to address accumulated environmental and social costs.

stories.title: Incendies en Gironde et dans les Landes : l'aide aux entreprises est prolongée

en.title: Fires in Gironde and Landes: business aid extended
en.summary: France has extended emergency financial assistance for businesses affected by summer wildfires until October 4. The aid helps small companies by covering the difference between partial activity allowances.

stories.title: OPINION. "De la Lumière… presque à tous les étages"

en.title: OPINION. "Light... almost at every level"
en.summary: The Lumière Summit announced a one billion euro fund for French cinema, but questions remain about whether such commitments can adequately protect the industry amid artificial intelligence, streaming platforms, and budget cuts.

stories.title: Saisie des actifs russes d'Auchan, Nestlé et Leroy Merlin : Paris hausse le ton contre Moscou

en.title: Seizure of Russian assets of Auchan, Nestlé and Leroy Merlin: Paris takes harder line against Moscow
en.summary: France condemned Russia's placement of Russian subsidiaries of Auchan, Nestlé and Leroy Merlin under state control. The Kremlin's decision may lead to forced asset sales.

stories.title: OPINION. « 2027 : quel espace pour notre souveraineté narrative ? » (François Tron)

en.title: OPINION. "2027: what space for our narrative sovereignty?" (François Tron)
en.summary: The article argues that the state must respond to digital transformation, and that new media regulation is needed to protect French media outlets, their funding, and the nation's ability to shape its own collective narrative.
